muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿إنا﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿أرسلنا﴾: a past verb; ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); and the clause أرسلنا is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿نوحًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلى قومه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾.
﴿أن﴾: maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), construed together with what it governs as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); the (implied) preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾, the meaning being: "We sent him by saying to him: Warn." Or it is explicative (mufassira), because "sending" contains the meaning of "saying".
﴿أنذر﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).
﴿قومك﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿من قبل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنذر﴾.
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle.
﴿يأتيهم﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يأتيهم﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿عذاب﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿أليم﴾: a naʿt (adjective), nominative.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿قال﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle.
﴿قوم﴾: the one addressed (munādā), in construct (muḍāf), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the first person; and the yāʾ of the first person is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إني﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نذير﴾.
﴿نذير﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma.
﴿مبين﴾: a naʿt (adjective), nominative.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿أن﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), construed with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e.: "that you worship" (بأن اعبدوا). The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نذير﴾. And the clause ﴿اعبدوا الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position.
﴿اعبدوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿واتقوه﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اعبدوا, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وأطيعون﴾: likewise conjoined, and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ of the first person was omitted for lightness, to match the verse-endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿يغفر﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the command; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغفر﴾.
﴿من ذنوبكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun in the place of the accusative as the object of يغفر, because من is partitive, i.e.: "some of your sins"; and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ويؤخركم﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يغفر; its fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلى أجل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤخركم﴾.
﴿مسمى﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أجل﴾, genitive (majrūr) by an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible.
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿أجل﴾: the ism (noun) of inna, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb for future time, putting its condition clause in the genitive, attached to its response.
﴿جاء﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil latent; and the clause جاء is in the position of the genitive by the adverb being put in annexation to it.
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يؤخر﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive); and the clause لا يؤخر has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿لو﴾: conditional.
﴿كنتم﴾: kāna is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its ism.
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; and the clause تعلمون is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. The apodosis of لو is omitted, just as the object of تعلمون is omitted, i.e.: "if you knew that, you would believe".

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿قال﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir).
﴿ربّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), in construct (muḍāf), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ of the first person is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the vocative particle is omitted.
﴿إني﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿دعوت﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; and the clause دعوت is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿قومي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ليلا﴾: an adverb, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دعوت﴾.
﴿ونهارًا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ليلا﴾; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿فلم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لم is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿يزدهم﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿دعائي﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿فرارًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; and the exception is "emptied" (mufarragh, i.e. with no stated excepted-from).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وإني﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿كلما﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ is a substitute for an adverb of time (nāʾib ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعلوا﴾, containing the meaning of condition; and ﴿ما﴾ is temporal maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya zamāniyya). The clause ﴿دعوتهم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; and ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is construed as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is genitive (majrūr) by annexation, its implied form being: "every calling", which is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e.: "every time of calling". Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified by what follows (nakira mawṣūfa), meaning ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), the referential pronoun being omitted, its implied form being: "every time I called them in it so that You might forgive them"; in that case the clause ﴿دعوتهم﴾ is in the position of the genitive as an attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿دعوتهم﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿لتغفر﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and تغفر is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the causal lām; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are construed as a maṣdar that is genitive by the causal lām; and the causal lām with its genitive noun are attached to ﴿دعوتهم﴾.
﴿لهم﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تغفر﴾.
﴿جعلوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; and the clause جعلوا has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, namely كلما.
﴿أصابعهم﴾: the first object of جعلوا; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿في آذانهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جعلوا﴾ in the sense of "they placed".
﴿واستغشوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to جعلوا.
﴿ثيابهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿وأصروا واستكبروا﴾: likewise two conjoined (verbs).
﴿استكبارا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). And the condition clause with its apodosis is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ثم﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī).
﴿إني﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿دعوتهم﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause دعوتهم is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿جهارًا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a type of the maṣdar or its attribute; it may also be a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "openly", or "possessing openness".

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿ثم﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī).
﴿إني﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿أعلنت﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلنت﴾. And the clause أعلنت is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿وأسررت﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أعلنت.
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسررت﴾.
﴿إسرارًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿فقلت﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قلت is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿استغفروا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿ربكم﴾: the word رب is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إنه﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿كان﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its ism latent (mustatir).
﴿غفارا﴾: the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); the clause كان is the khabar of inna; the clause استغفروا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause إنه كان غفارًا has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for seeking forgiveness.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿يرسل﴾: يرسل is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the command; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah the Exalted.
﴿السماء﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يرسل﴾.
﴿مدرارا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from السماء.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ويمددكم﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يرسل: يمدد is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), conjoined to يرسل; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بأموال﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يمددكم﴾.
﴿وبنين﴾: conjoined to أموال.
﴿ويجعل﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to ﴿ويمددكم﴾.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿جنات﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ويجعل لكم أنهارًا﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of ما.
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿ترجون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause لا ترجون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf in لكم.
﴿لله﴾: the lām is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, because the lām is for clarification (tabyīn); had it come later, it would have been an attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿الوقار﴾. [Translator's note: so in the source, with the article; the word in the ayah is ﴿وقارا﴾.]
﴿وقارا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿ترجون﴾.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وقد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq).
﴿خلقكم﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ترجون.
﴿أطوارًا﴾: a ḥāl interpreted as a derived word (muʾawwala bi-l-mushtaqq), i.e.: "passing from one state to another".

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and لم is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿تروا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the "seeing" is cognitive (ʿilmiyya), i.e.: "have you not taken heed and reflected?"
﴿كيف﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), the governing word for it being خلق.
﴿خلق﴾: a past verb.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause stands in place of the two objects of تروا, which is suspended from operating (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.
﴿سبع﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿سماوات﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿طباقًا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سبع﴾, or accusative by an omitted verb, i.e.: "they were layered in layers" (طبقت طباقًا); it would then be the maṣdar of طابقت, (whose maṣdars are) مطابقة and طباق.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وجعل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جعل is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir).
﴿القمر﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فيهن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعل﴾.
﴿نورًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وجعل الشمس سراجًا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الله is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أنبتكم﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause أنبتكم is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿من الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنبتكم﴾.
﴿نباتا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿يعيدكم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعيدكم﴾.
﴿ويخرجكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and يخرجكم is an imperfect verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يعيدكم﴾, nominative; its fāʿil is latent, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إخراجا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الله is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿جعل﴾: جعل is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); and the clause جعل is the khabar (predicate).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعل﴾.
﴿الأرض﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بساطًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿لتسلكوا﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl), and تسلكوا is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are construed as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is genitive by the lām of cause; and the lām of cause with its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعل﴾.
﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿سبلا﴾.
﴿سبلا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فجاجا﴾: a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿قال﴾: a past verb.
﴿نوح﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma.
﴿رب﴾: the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb), in construct with the omitted yāʾ of the first person; and the omitted yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إنهم﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿عصوني﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied ḍamma on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya); and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause عصوني is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the (whole) clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿واتبعوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to عصوني.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿يزده﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ماله﴾: fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وولده﴾: conjoined to ماله.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿خسارًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يزده﴾.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ومكروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; مكروا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿مكرا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿كبارا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿مكرا﴾.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿وقالوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قالوا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿لا﴾: prohibitive (nāhiya).
﴿تذرن﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil; and the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis (nūn al-tawkīd al-thaqīla).
﴿آلهتكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولا تذرن﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first لا تذرن.
﴿ودًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is connective (ṣila).
﴿سواعا﴾: conjoined to ﴿ودًّا﴾, accusative by the fatḥa.
﴿ولا يغوث﴾: likewise conjoined to ﴿ودا﴾.
﴿ويعوق﴾: likewise conjoined to ﴿ودا﴾; and the two words ﴿يغوث ويعوق﴾ are diptotes (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) because of being proper names and having the pattern of a verb, if they are Arabic, and because of being proper names and foreign, if they are non-Arabic.
﴿ونسرا﴾: likewise conjoined to ﴿ودا﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿وقد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); the clause قد أضلوا is the object of an omitted saying conjoined to the preceding قال, i.e.: "he said: They have disobeyed me, and he said: They have led astray".
﴿أضلوا﴾: a verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿كثيرًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw conjoins to the omitted saying, and لا is the lā of request, for supplication (duʿāʾ).
﴿تزد﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾.
﴿الظالمين﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿ضلالا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿مما﴾: من is a preposition, and ما is connective (ṣila).
﴿خطيئاتهم﴾: genitive (majrūr) by the causal من; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أغرقوا﴾.
﴿أغرقوا﴾: a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿فأدخلوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أغرقوا﴾.
﴿نارا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa).
﴿فلم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لم is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿يجدوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn; and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second object.
﴿من دون﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أنصارا﴾: the first object of ﴿يجدوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿وقال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and قال is a past verb.
﴿نوح﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma.
﴿رب﴾: the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb), in construct with the omitted yāʾ of the first person; and the omitted yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of request, for supplication (duʿāʾ).
﴿تذر﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾.
﴿على الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تذر﴾.
﴿من الكافرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿ديارا﴾.
﴿ديارا﴾: the object of تذر.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿إنك﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its ism (noun); and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿تذرهم﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يضلوا﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn; and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿عبادك﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negating.
﴿يلدوا﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يضلوا﴾, jussive; and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿فاجرا﴾: the object of يضلوا. [Translator's note: so in the source; ﴿فاجرا﴾ is the object of ﴿يلدوا﴾, the verb it follows.]
﴿كفارا﴾: a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿رب﴾: the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb), in construct with the omitted yāʾ of the first person; and the omitted yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿اغفر﴾: a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت).
﴿لي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اغفر﴾.
﴿ولوالدي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لوالدي is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿لي﴾, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ; and the yāʾ of the first person is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ولمن﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿دخل﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir).
﴿بيتي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; and the yāʾ of the first person is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿دخل بيتي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿مؤمنا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative.
﴿وللمؤمنين﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿والمؤمنات﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is the lā of request, for supplication.
﴿تزد﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾.
﴿الظالمين﴾: first mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿تبارا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
